title: Cyberwave Simulation Hardware Qualification
description: The hardware fingerprint an Isaac Sim worker's qualification probe records. A worker joins the Isaac pool only while its latest record has status 'pass', an RT-core NVIDIA GPU with a 16 GB card (at least 15872 MiB reported total VRAM, see MIN_ISAAC_VRAM_MIB), a resolved plant image digest (matching the expected one where the platform sets it), and a checked_at within the freshness window. There is no GPU-model list and no driver pin. The worker stores its latest record in its cloud-node metadata under 'hardware_qualification'. The schema accepts failing records so a probe can report why it failed; cyberwave_contracts.simulation.check_hardware_qualification decides whether a record qualifies, failing closed. Contains no credentials, hostnames or URLs.

probe_version.description: Version of the qualification probe that produced this record.

checked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the probe run. A record older than the freshness window is stale.

gpu_model.description: GPU model as the driver reports it, e.g. 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti'.

rt_cores.description: Whether the GPU has RT cores. Isaac Sim does not run without them (e.g. A100, H100).

vram_mib.description: Total VRAM of the GPU assigned to Isaac workloads, in MiB.

image_digest.description: Digest of the Isaac plant image the runtime probe ran. A record without one never qualifies.

provisional.description: True when a development-mode probe waived checks a production node must pass (a runtime probe that was not run). A provisional record qualifies only where the platform explicitly allows it (Cyberwave's internal development and test deployments).

provisional_reasons.description: The checks a provisional record waived.

execution_profiles.description: Execution profiles whose physics the runtime probe stepped. When present, a worker qualifies only for these; when absent, for every profile.

driver.description: nvidia-smi reported a valid driver version.

runtime_probe.description: NVIDIA compatibility checker, headless Kit start, RTX render, physics steps, encode and clean shutdown.
